format: Historical snapshots are verbatim UTF-8 .source files. A stable snapshot lists the same logical paths: each is either the historical bytes it derives from or a migrated .source blob that the recorded migration rules produce from them. A copy removes only the storage suffix.
license: The snapshots contain no root LICENSE and the owning package manifests declare no license. Operator-owned source is copied under the assignment's explicit authority; no upstream license grant is invented. Effect is an installed MIT dependency, not vendored application source.
